tokens.name: rd-canvas
tokens.usage: Page and panel background for Raiden views. Matches GitHub's canvas so injected views sit flush.

tokens.name: rd-canvas-subtle
tokens.usage: Secondary panels, table headers, alternate iteration bands on the timeline.

tokens.name: rd-canvas-inset
tokens.usage: Inset wells: the timeline track, code blocks, empty states.

tokens.name: rd-overlay
tokens.usage: Popovers, menus and dialogs. Always pair with `rd-shadow-overlay`.

tokens.name: rd-border
tokens.usage: Edges of cards, panels and table rows. Decorative: under 3:1, so never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: rd-border-control
tokens.usage: Edges of inputs, checkboxes and secondary buttons. Meets 3:1 on every canvas.

tokens.name: rd-border-muted
tokens.usage: Dividers and timeline grid lines. Never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: rd-fg
tokens.usage: Primary text on every canvas and on `rd-overlay`.

tokens.name: rd-fg-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, metadata, axis labels. On `rd-canvas`, `rd-canvas-subtle`, `rd-overlay`.

tokens.name: rd-fg-subtle
tokens.usage: Icons, placeholders and disabled text only. Meets 3:1 on `rd-canvas`; never body copy.

tokens.name: rd-brand
tokens.usage: Raiden's signature teal. Fill for primary buttons, the active sprint, the today line. Marks what Raiden adds to the page.

tokens.name: rd-brand-fg
tokens.usage: Brand-colored text and icons on `rd-canvas`, `rd-canvas-subtle` and `rd-brand-muted`.

tokens.name: rd-on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an `rd-brand` fill.

tokens.name: rd-brand-muted
tokens.usage: Tinted ground for the current sprint, the sprint-goal card and selected rows.

tokens.name: rd-accent
tokens.usage: Links, focus rings and selected states, as on GitHub. Text on every canvas.

tokens.name: rd-accent-muted
tokens.usage: Hover and selection ground behind `rd-accent` text.

tokens.name: rd-success
tokens.usage: Done stories, a met sprint goal. Text on `rd-canvas` and `rd-success-muted`.

tokens.name: rd-success-muted
tokens.usage: Ground for success pills and completed timeline segments.

tokens.name: rd-attention
tokens.usage: At-risk epics, a partly met goal, the `needs-design` label. Text on `rd-canvas` and `rd-attention-muted`.

tokens.name: rd-attention-muted
tokens.usage: Ground for attention pills.

tokens.name: rd-danger
tokens.usage: Blocked stories, a missed goal, destructive actions. Text on `rd-canvas` and `rd-danger-muted`.

tokens.name: rd-danger-muted
tokens.usage: Ground for blocked pills and the blocked-by rail.

tokens.name: rd-done
tokens.usage: Closed epics and approved decision records, matching GitHub's closed-as-completed purple.

tokens.name: rd-done-muted
tokens.usage: Ground for done pills.

tokens.name: rd-epic
tokens.usage: Epic bars, the epic diamond glyph and epic labels on the timeline.

tokens.name: rd-epic-muted
tokens.usage: Ground for epic rows and the unfilled part of an epic bar.

tokens.name: rd-story
tokens.usage: Story circle glyph and story bars.

tokens.name: rd-story-muted
tokens.usage: Unfilled part of a story bar.

tokens.name: rd-decision
tokens.usage: Decision-record square glyph and labels.

tokens.name: rd-decision-muted
tokens.usage: Ground for decision-record pills.

families.display: "Bricolage Grotesque", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "Noto Sans", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
families.sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "Noto Sans", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
families.mono: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", monospace

styles.name: goal-lg
styles.sample: Ship the epic timeline to the pilot team
styles.usage: The sprint goal statement in its card. One per view.

styles.name: view-title
styles.usage: Title of a Raiden view (sprint header, timeline header).

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The word Raiden in the banner.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Section and card titles inside a view.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Roll stories up to their epic to see whether it lands this quarter.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Issue titles in rows, emphasis inside body.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Updated 2 hours ago by the lead

styles.name: axis
styles.usage: Timeline axis labels and column eyebrows, uppercase.

tokens.name: rd-space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap, pill inner padding.

tokens.name: rd-space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between controls; row padding on the timeline.

tokens.name: rd-space-3
tokens.usage: Button horizontal padding; gap inside cards.

tokens.name: rd-space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; gutter of a Raiden view.

tokens.name: rd-space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between sections of a view.

tokens.name: rd-space-8
tokens.usage: Padding of the sprint-goal hero.

tokens.name: rd-header-height
tokens.usage: Height of the banner, matching GitHub's top header.

tokens.name: rd-header-padding
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding of the banner, matching GitHub's top header.

tokens.name: rd-header-icon
tokens.usage: Size of the Raiden icon in the banner.

tokens.name: rd-radius-sm
tokens.usage: Timeline bars, checkboxes, the decision square glyph.

tokens.name: rd-radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, cards — GitHub's control radius.

tokens.name: rd-radius-lg
tokens.usage: The sprint-goal card and popovers. Raiden's own surfaces only.

tokens.name: rd-radius-full
tokens.usage: Pills, counters, the story circle glyph.

tokens.name: rd-shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Resting cards and buttons.

tokens.name: rd-shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Popovers, menus, dialogs.

tokens.name: rd-shadow-glow
tokens.usage: Raiden's signature glow: the sprint-goal card and the active sprint column. At most one glowing element per view.
